key: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour soaked.
s: Setting out the peace-offerings, the law turns to the offering of thanks; the Midrash, Leviticus Rabbah 9:7, reads it as lasting when all else ends: in the time to come every offering will cease but the thank-offering, and every prayer but thanksgiving.
